plugins.description: School always-on display screensaver with timetable, meals, weather, and quotes.
plugins.author: Schun

preview.tagline: A calm always-on display for classrooms and desks
preview.about: Schun AOD turns a spare screen into a school display: a live clock, today's timetable, the cafeteria menu, weather and a daily quote on one dimmed, burn-in friendly screen. Pick your school and class inside OPUS and NEIS timetable and meal data load without any extra setup.
features: Clock, date and today's timetable at a glance
NEIS cafeteria menu for the current week
Weather from your school, your location or a place you pick
Pixel shift and brightness control to protect OLED screens
Every widget can be switched on or off
